links.outcome: Causes of autosegmentation outliers under real-world imaging variations such as contrast and devices
links.effect: Barium contrast caused incomplete stomach delineation in 10/12 Limbus outliers and 21/25 Radformation outliers; IV contrast linked to fragmented kidney contours in MIM (25/26 outliers).
links.quote: Only Limbus and Radformation provided stomach segmentation, and imaging with barium contrast directly caused incomplete stomach delineation in 10/12 Limbus outliers and 21/25 Radformation outliers.

unlisted_practices: Outlier and failure-mode analysis of commercial autosegmentation tools to inform acceptance criteria and vendor improvement

screen.reason: Evaluates the geometric accuracy and failure modes/outliers of four commercial deep-learning autocontouring systems on retrospective patient data, but does not test a specific deployment safeguard or practice intervention.
